existing_features.title: Create a single-page interactive apology experience that asks: "Kiki, will you forgive me?" with two prominent buttons: "Yes" and "No".

Implement playful 'No' button behavior: when the user tries to click or hover/tap the "No" button, it should move to a different position within a bounded container so it is difficult to click, and show escalating prompt text such as: "Please think again" / "Are you sure?" / "Give me one more chance".

When the user clicks "Yes", transition to a 'forgiven' state that (a) displays a cute animation (e.g., hearts/confetti burst) and (b) shows a final message in English conveying the original intent: "Thank you. From today I will change the way I speak. I never doubted you. Please forgive me."

Add an endless 'falling emojis' effect that continuously drops crying and sad emojis from the top of the screen (e.g., 😢, 😭, 😞). The effect should be active at least after the user clicks "Yes" (and may optionally be subtle on the initial screen).

Apply a coherent, cute, romantic visual theme (not blue/purple) across the page: warm pastel background, rounded card layout, friendly typography, and subtle micro-interactions (button hover/press states).

In the forgiveness/thank-you screen shown after clicking "Yes" (the forgiven state in frontend/src/App.tsx), replace the current sentence "I never doubted you, not even for a moment. 💕" with the user's exact provided sentence below, preserving it exactly as written (no translation, no rewording, keep punctuation/casing/spacing as provided): "sorry mujhe maaf kardo, mere bolne se aapko shak lagta hai but mai nahi karta hun shak aapse , sorry kiki aaj se try karunga sahi se baat karna I'm really sorry aapko asa feel karane keliye".

In the post-"Yes" forgiven/thank-you screen in frontend/src/App.tsx, remove the sentence "Thank you so much for forgiving me. 😢" so it is no longer displayed to the user.
